name: design-os-generative-ui
description: Stream-first interactive visual runtime for AI agents — 60fps `morphdom` DOM reconciliation, streaming HTML sanitizer, and WebGL/Canvas widget bridge.

interface.shortDescription: Stream-first interactive visual runtime for AI agents — 60fps `morphdom` DOM reconciliation, streaming HTML sanitizer, and WebGL/Canvas widget bridge.
interface.longDescription: Render live-streaming interactive calculators, 3D scenes, charts, and explorable explanations inside Claude Artifacts, ChatGPT Canvas, Gemini, and custom agent webviews with zero flicker.
defaultPrompt: Build a stream-safe interactive compound-interest and Monte Carlo simulator widget using DesignOSBridge and Chart.js.
Wrap our LLM token stream in createStreamRenderer so incomplete HTML tags reconcile at 60fps via morphdom without resetting canvas state.
Audit this generative UI widget against the DESIGN:OS interactive widget guidelines (zero raw emojis, dark-mode adaptive tokens, and XSS sanitization).
